name: [[700,100,15]] weight-6 pair-partition CPM CSS code on a sparse 6x14 template, P = 50

provenance.notes: Witnessed distance upper bound d_X <= 15, d_Z <= 15 verified with 1.2M combined C++ bitboard RIS trials (no lighter logical found) plus orbit-fold and validate_candidate checks. Achieves kd^2/n = 32.14 at check weight 6 with rate k/n = 1/7 at n = 700 <= 700. Authored by Carsen Klock (@metaspartan).

contributed_by.method: Balanced 4-module chiplet partition minimizing cross-module checks (468/600 checks cross-module) via simulated annealing; Gemini 4 Neon / Cybara.
